items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I was with Cab Calloway with Milt Hinton... He got together a bunch of older guys... myself, Milt Hinton on bass... and we recorded.

ctx.x: I understand that you got to play with Milt Hinton in a group called The Survivors?
